metadata.title: Primitive Betti points over k[x,y,z] and the Heisenberg enveloping algebra: the point (1,2,2,1) on (0,e,3e,4e) fails only in characteristic 2 for 2 <= e <= 16 with e != 11, is realized whenever an odd prime p divides e(e-1) or equals 2e-1, and a census for d_3 <= 12
metadata.description:
Erman and Sam asked whether every integral point on a pure ray of the Boij-Söderberg cone is the Betti table of a finite length module over k[x,y,z] or over the enveloping algebra U of the Heisenberg Lie algebra; Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu answered negatively. We study the point (1,2,2,1) on (0,e,3e,4e), excluded over k[x,y,z] and passing their test over U. It is realized by U/U(x^e,y^e) if and only if char k = 0 or char k >= 2e, and in characteristic 2 no module with at most one more relation than generators has finite length over U.

In odd characteristic p we prove a criterion for pairs of forms with a central commutator, with explicit pure pairs for e = 0 or 1 modulo p, and pull-backs along endomorphisms of U. For the pairs x^e + alpha y^t, y^e + beta x^t we prove that coprimality conditions, two congruences and one scalar condition give the pure Hilbert function when p >= 2t, and the pure pair when one more coprimality holds; explicit short pairs are pure for p = 2e - 1 (every prime p >= 5) and for p = 2e - 3 (the primes below 2,000,000). Searches in weight-class strata, lists of forms, the filter for every exponent and the members fixed by the exchange of x and y settle the other pairs.

The point is realized in every characteristic other than 2 for 2 <= e <= 16 except e = 11, where characteristic 3 is open. A census of the 220 rays with d_3 <= 12 over k[x,y,z] realizes the primitive point on 193 and excludes it on 12; in characteristic 0 the least counterexample has d_3 = 10.

Source code, data and computational records: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH (branch develop). The paper does not claim a negative answer to Question 6.1 of Erman and Sam, which is due to Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu, and claims no priority for any other result.

metadata.version_notes: Adds to v0.02 a criterion for the purity of pairs of forms with a central commutator in odd characteristic, the endomorphisms of the enveloping algebra and the scaling of Betti tables, the weight-class and weight-zero-projection exclusions, the decomposition over k[xy,z] of the pairs x^e + alpha y^t, y^e + beta x^t with the theorems on the pure Hilbert function and on the pure Betti table, and explicit pairs of the linear family for p = 2e - 1 and p = 2e - 3, with the searches that use them (strata, lists of forms, the filter for every exponent, the members fixed by the exchange of x and y). The point (1,2,2,1) on (0,e,3e,4e) is now realized in every characteristic other than 2 for 2 <= e <= 16 except e = 11, where characteristic 3 is open; the machine checks of the new statements are archived.
